leb.text: Benalia appears on this set's cards as a land with a caste system that changes with the lunar year.

plc.text: In Benalia, Pol Cordel told Gerrard that a Talruum had arrived aboard a flying ship, and Gerrard guessed that Sisay had come looking for him, recalling that chasing the Legacy had cost the lives of friends and was why he left the Weatherlight.
Cordel's argument persuaded him to see the docks, where he heard Tahngarth roaring at a missionary of the Church of Angelfire and ran to calm him, and the two were reunited.

Tahngarth told him they had come because something terrible had happened to Sisay, so Gerrard decided to return to the Weatherlight and left his hourglass pendant, the only part of the Legacy he kept, in Cordel's keeping.
The next morning the Weatherlight, with Gerrard aboard, set sail from Benalia.
